confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Beijing price levels for July 2026. No live booking pages, menus, or current listings were inspected. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately certain; the 3-star hotel and the mid-range meal are the least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass have weak direct knowledge, so they were set from the local price relationship to beer (roughly 4.3 to 4.8 times the beer anchor). FX provenance is limited: the 0.6955 figure for 15 October 2026 was taken from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates page, which I did not open directly. Other search results gave conflicting RBA-attributed values (0.6979 for 9 October via a third-party site), so the figure should be verified against the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to general mid-tier pricing for large Chinese tier-one cities, using Shanghai as the closest comparable for restaurant and hotel levels. Accommodation tiers reflect Beijing's registered hostel and hotel stock, and beverage anchors follow the local beer price relationship.
